exposure: Women who got pregnant during breastfeeding (PDBF) and women who got pregnant after weaning (PAW)
finding: Pregnancy during breastfeeding was associated with an increase in overall pregnancy complications compared to pregnancy after weaning, including higher rates of maternal anemia, delayed fetal growth, prolonged labor, cesarean section delivery, and low birth weight infants.
mod_finding: Pregnancy during breastfeeding was associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was higher in the pregnancy during breastfeeding group
